verdict.rationale: Simular's Sai and Agent-S are documented to operate desktop and web apps by clicking, typing, and scrolling. Their supported targets are cloud Windows/Linux computers and the user's own Mac or Windows PC. Nothing shows the agent tapping, swiping, or typing on a real phone. Phone-related mentions (iMessage/SMS/Telegram notifications and approvals) concern messaging the user, not device control. Agent-S's 'across environments' claim is too vague to count.
